137. Interpellations and Resolution.—

—   (1) A member of Zilla Panchayat may move 
resolutions and interpellate the Adhyaksha of Zilla Panchayat on matters connected with 
the administration of the Zilla Panchayat, subject to such regulations as may be made by 
the Zilla Panchayat. 
 
 (2) A member of the Zilla Panchayat may also call the attention of the Adhyaksha to 
any neglect in the execution of the work of the Zilla Panchayat, to any waste of property 
belonging to of the Zilla Panchayat, or to the wants of any locality within the district and 
may suggest any improvements, which may appear desirable.
